title: EnvironmentSpec
description: Declarative description of how to materialize an environment's profile directory. Implementations accept this as the input to create*().

adapter_id.description: Stable identifier of the adapter this env is for. 'generic' for direct usage without an adapter.

env_overrides.description: Environment variables to surface on the resulting Environment.env_overrides. Values may contain the literal placeholder '$EPHEMERAL_HOME', which the implementation MUST replace with the absolute path of the profile directory at creation time. By convention, only agent-specific config vars (e.g. CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR, CODEX_HOME) are set; HOME is intentionally NOT overridden by default.

seed_files.description: Map of relative path → file contents. Paths must be relative; '..' components are forbidden. Files are written under the profile directory at creation time.

file_modes.description: Map of relative path → POSIX mode bits (e.g. 384 for 0o600). Applied after seed_files. Ignored on non-Unix platforms.

credentials.description: Credential payload to write into the profile dir. Same shape as seed_files but materially distinct in semantics: refresh_credentials() re-runs only this part. Implementations also default to mode 0600 for credential files unless overridden by file_modes.

prefix.description: tmpdir prefix for ephemeral envs. Ignored for persistent envs.
